description: This Java source file defines the CalculatorUI class, which provides a Swing-based graphical user interface for a calculator application. It manages UI components such as display, number buttons, and operation buttons, and interacts with the Calculator backend to perform calculations.

classes.name: CalculatorUI
classes.description: A Swing-based user interface class for the calculator, extending JFrame and implementing TextProvider and ActionListener to handle display updates and user actions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to launch the calculator UI.

methods.name: CalculatorUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the calculator backend and sets up the GUI components.

methods.name: setupGUI
methods.description: Initializes the main GUI layout, including display and buttons.

methods.name: setupDisplay
methods.description: Creates and configures the display text field.

methods.name: setupButtonsPanel
methods.description: Creates the panel that holds number and operation buttons.

methods.name: setupNumberButtons
methods.description: Creates number buttons (0-9 and decimal point).

methods.name: addNumberButton
methods.description: Adds a single number button to the UI.

methods.name: setupCommandButtons
methods.description: Creates operation buttons based on the Operations instance.

methods.name: addCommandButton
methods.description: Adds an operation button to the UI.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles button click events and delegates to the calculator logic.

methods.name: setDisplayText
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with the given text.

methods.name: getDisplayText
methods.description: Returns the current text from the display.
